name: MongoDB - Replication Logs
description: This dashboard shows replication events, errors, warnings, and nodes.
title: MongoDB - Replication Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceHost={{host}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw 
| json field=_raw "t.$date" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "s" as severity
| json field=_raw "c" as component
| json field=_raw "ctx" as context
| json field=_raw "msg" as msg
| where severity = "W" and  component matches "*REPL*"
| count

_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceHost={{host}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw 
| json field=_raw "t.$date" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "s" as severity
| json field=_raw "c" as component
| json field=_raw "ctx" as context
| json field=_raw "msg" as msg
| where severity = "E" and  component matches "*REPL*"
| count by timestamp, severity, component, context , msg
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceHost={{host}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw 
| json field=_raw "t.$date" as timestamp
| json field=_raw "s" as severity
| json field=_raw "c" as component
| json field=_raw "ctx" as context
| json field=_raw "msg" as msg
| where component matches "*REPL*"  and !(msg matches "Waiting for pings from other members before syncing") and !(msg matches "Error in heartbeat") and !(msg matches "Not starting an election, since we are not electable")
| count by timestamp, severity, context , msg
| order by timestamp 
| limit 100
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/MongoDB db_cluster={{db_cluster}} _sourceHost={{host}} db_system=mongodb | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as _raw

| json field=_raw "s" as severity
